# `listView` (Content)

<!-- GENERATED by `dart run tool/reference.dart`. Do not edit. -->

A list. `itemBuilder` is built once per item of `data`. Inside `scroll` it moves with the page; on its own (in `expanded`) it scrolls itself.

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `data` | value | value returning a list |
| `itemBuilder` | node | values and actions inside get `index` |
| `empty` | node |  |

Kinds are explained in REFERENCE.md (Widgets). Icons, colors and text variants: style.md.
